headline: Filed from the couch, replayed on the rig
lede: The feedback button's missing twin shipped: point feedbackreplay at any filed report and it re-drives your last 30 seconds of play against the live game — real key events, exact tick grid, progress and error gates included. Slot a added dictation on top the same night.

notes.text: PR #1466 (merged 21:32Z) ships scripts/feedbackreplay.mjs — npm run feedbackreplay <issue-n> extracts the rec/v1 stream from a filed FEEDBACK issue, shape-gates it (every violation names itself), then replays it as real key events against the live game with zero-page-error + progress gates and a key timeline. #737's QA leg is now machine-side done.
#737 keeps moving: slot a resumed it and merged the DICTATION leg (dfe918c) — the panel now takes dictated notes in games and demos. The issue waits on Jon's three phone reports.

Shift hazard + fix, recorded: system DNS died mid-shift (dead Tailscale MagicDNS, no sudo) and gh's Go TLS rejected GitHub's Sectigo chain (OSStatus -26276). Rescue kit (/tmp/forge/rescue: CONNECT proxy on 18080 + gh REST shim + Node DNS preload; source /tmp/forge/env.sh) carried the whole shift and survived the temp-dir cleaner. Chrome stays SIGABRT-blocked in this sandbox — browser-tier checks belong to healthy lanes.
